preToolUse.bash: p='.github/hooks/command-safety.sh'; r=$(cd -P . && pwd); case $r in /*) ;; *) r=;; esac; while [ -n "$r" ] && ! [ -f "$r/$p" ]; do [ "$r" = / ] && r= || { r=${r%/*}; [ -n "$r" ] || r=/; }; done; [ -n "$r" ] || { echo "kendex: no directory above $PWD holds $p; run kendex refresh in the project" >&2; exit 1; }; bash "$r/$p"
